arxiv-2102-03633.title: High Energy Behaviour of Light Meson Photoproduction
arxiv-2102-03633.creator: Moskov J. Amaryan, William J. Briscoe, Michael G. Ryskin, Igor I. Strakovsky
arxiv-2102-03633.description: Abstract We evaluated CLAS Collaboration measurements for the 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} meson photoproduction off the nucleon using a tagged photon beam spanning the energy interval s = 3 − 11 s=3-11 GeV 2 . The results are compared with the ”Quark Counting Rules” predictions.

arxiv-2103-02415.creator: D. Belver, J. Boix, E. Calvo, C. Cuesta, A. Gallego-Ros, I. Gil-Botella, S. Jiménez, C. Lastoria, T. Lux, I. Martín, J.J. Martínez, C. Palomares, J. Soto-Oton, A. Verdugo

arxiv-2103-07733.title: ReDet: A Rotation-equivariant Detector for Aerial Object Detection
arxiv-2103-07733.creator: Jiaming Han ∗, Jian Ding ∗, Nan Xue, Gui-Song Xia Wuhan University, Wuhan, China {hanjiaming, jian.ding, xuenan, guisong.xia}@whu.edu.cn
arxiv-2103-07733.description: Abstract Recently, object detection in aerial images has gained much attention in computer vision. Different from objects in natural images, aerial objects are often distributed with arbitrary orientation. Therefore, the detector requires more parameters to encode the orientation information, which are often highly redundant and inefficient.

arxiv-2108-09897.title: A Weakly Supervised Amodal Segmenter with Boundary Uncertainty Estimation
arxiv-2108-09897.creator: Khoi Nguyen, Sinisa Todorovic
arxiv-2108-09897.description: Abstract This paper addresses weakly supervised amodal instance segmentation, where the goal is to segment both visible and occluded (amodal) object parts, while training provides only ground-truth visible (modal) segmentations. Following prior work, we use data manipulation to generate occlusions in training images and thus train a segmenter to predict amodal segmentations of the manipulated data.

arxiv-2310-14443.title: Submodular Optimization for Placement of Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces in sensing systems
arxiv-2310-14443.creator: Zahra Esmaeilbeig, Kumar Vijay Mishra, Arian Eamaz, Mojtaba Soltanalian
arxiv-2310-14443.description: Abstract Intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRS) are increasingly being investigated for novel sensing applications for improving target estimation and detection. While the optimization of IRS phase-shifts has been studied extensively, the optimal placement of multiple IRS platforms for sensing applications is relatively unexamined.

arxiv-2402-06042.title: Solving high dimensional FBSDE with deep signature techniques with application to nonlinear options pricing
arxiv-2402-06042.creator: Hui Sun, Feng bao
arxiv-2402-06042.description: Abstract We report two methods for solving FBSDEs of path dependent types of high dimensions. Inspired by the work from [ 5 ] , [ 6 ] and [ 19 ] , we propose a deep learning framework for solving such problems using path signatures as underlying features.

arxiv-2402-13633.title: Rings whose subrings are all Noetherian or Artinian
arxiv-2402-13633.creator: Nathan Blacher
arxiv-2402-13633.description: Abstract We study noncommutative rings whose proper subrings all satisfy the same chain condition. We show that if every proper subring of a ring R R is right Noetherian, then R R is either right Noetherian or the trivial extension of ℤ \mathbb{Z} by the Prüfer p p -group for a prime p p .

arxiv-2412-02180.title: Study of the optical losses as a function of beam position on the mirrors in a 285 m suspended Fabry-Perot cavity
arxiv-2412-02180.creator: Y. Zhao, M. Vardaro, E. Capocasa, J. Ding, Y. Guo, M. Lequime, M. Barsuglia
arxiv-2412-02180.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Y. Zhao, M. Vardaro, E. Capocasa, J. Ding, Y. Guo, M. Lequime, M. Barsuglia. Reducing optical losses is crucial for reducing quantum noise in gravitational-wave detectors. In fact, with equal input power, a lower level of round trip losses in the arm cavities allows to store more power. Moreover losses are the main source of degradation of the squeezed vacuum, which along with power increasing, is the most effective strategy to reduce quantum noise.

arxiv-2504-15030.title: Height-Dependent Slow Magnetoacoustic Wave Amplitude and Energy Flux in Sunspot Atmospheres
arxiv-2504-15030.creator: Y. Sanjay, S.Krishna Prasad, P.S. Rawat
arxiv-2504-15030.description: Abstract Slow magnetoacoustic waves (SMAWs) have been considered in the past a possible candidate for chromospheric heating. This study analyzed 20 active regions observed between 2012 and 2016 to examine the amplitude and energy flux variation of SMAWs in the umbral atmosphere.

arxiv-2512-02112.title: Observation of an anomaly in the statistics of Kibble-Zurek defects
arxiv-2512-02112.creator: Jan Balewski †, Alexey Khudorozhkov †, Siva Darbha, Omar A. Ashour, Fangli Liu, Ermal Rrapaj, Sheng-Tao Wang, Pedro L. S. Lopes, Katherine Klymko †, Milan Kornjača †, Daan Camps †
arxiv-2512-02112.description: Abstract The Kibble-Zurek mechanism quantifies defect formation during adiabatic passage across a continuous phase transition, providing key insights into universality in quantum many-body systems. We explore counting statistics of defects in adiabatic passage experiments on long 1D Rydberg atom chains.

arxiv-2601-07633.title: Performance Benchmarks for 2-View and 3-View Fiber-Projection Fine-Grained Particle Detectors
arxiv-2601-07633.creator: and Guang Yang † \dagger
arxiv-2601-07633.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by and Guang Yang † \dagger. Fine-grained scintillator detectors are critical for precision measurements in nuclear and particle physics, where accurate reconstruction of interaction vertices and secondary particle directions enables separation of signal from background events. A well-known design choice is the fiber readout geometry: traditional 2-View systems use orthogonal X and Y fibers, while next-generation 3-View designs add a third Z-fiber layer that provides unambiguous 3D voxel identification.

arxiv-2602-17015.title: Cinder: A fast and fair matchmaking system
arxiv-2602-17015.creator: Saurav Pal 1 ∗
arxiv-2602-17015.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Saurav Pal 1 ∗. A fair and fast matchmaking system is an important component of modern multiplayer online games, directly impacting player retention and satisfaction. However, creating fair matches between lobbies (pre-made teams) of heterogeneous skill levels presents a significant challenge. Matching based simply on average team skill metrics, such as mean or median rating or rank, often results in unbalanced and one-sided games, particularly when skill distributions are wide or skewed.

pmc-13589768.title: 谷胱甘肽在调控代谢相关脂肪性肝病铁死亡和铜死亡中的作用
pmc-13589768.creator: Sijia Liu, Yi Long, Lina Yang, 朴 田
pmc-13589768.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 代谢相关脂肪性肝病(metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease，MASLD)是以代谢功能障碍为核心特征的脂肪肝病，是全球肝病最常见的原因之一，可带来严重的疾病负担。异常的细胞死亡方式参与MASLD的发生与发展，铁死亡和铜死亡诱发并加重MASLD，成为新近研究热点。谷胱甘肽(glutathione，GSH)作为调节氧化还原过程最重要的还原剂，其含量下降或耗竭会促进肝脏脂质蓄积与氧化损伤，推动MASLD进展。GSH是铁死亡和铜死亡的共同枢纽：一方面，GSH作为谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4(glutathione peroxidase 4，GPX4)的必需还原底物，通过清除有毒脂质过氧化物来抑制铁死亡；另一方面，GSH能螯合细胞内过量的亚铜离子(Cu+)，降低Cu⁺在细胞内的毒性，从而抑制铜死亡。因此，GSH是调控MASLD铁死亡与铜死亡的关键，靶向GSH代谢通路有望成为预防、诊断与治疗MASLD的潜在新策略。未来可深入解析GSH调控铁死亡与铜死亡串扰的分子网络，并结合纳米靶向递送、基因编辑等新技术，开发安全高效的GSH靶向调节剂，推动基础研究成果向临床转化。Keywords: 谷胱甘肽, 代谢相关脂肪性肝病, 铁死亡, 铜死亡, 串扰, 氧化应激, 脂质过氧化

代谢相关脂肪性肝病(metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease，MASLD)过去被称为非酒精性脂肪肝病(nonalcoholic fatty liver disease，NAFLD)，是肝脏脂肪堆积与代谢功能障碍共存的疾病，其代谢异常表现为超重或肥胖及胰岛素抵抗。MASLD的特征是肝脏脂肪堆积(进而表现为肝脂肪变性)，伴有不同程度的炎症和纤维化[1]。研究[2]显示，MASLD全球患病率为30.2%，已成为全球公共卫生负担。如不及时治疗，MASLD常发展为代谢相关脂肪性肝炎(metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis，MASH)、肝纤维化甚至肝细胞癌(hepatocellular carcinoma，HCC)[2]，严重危害患者健康。

MASLD的发病涉及多种病理机制，其中氧化应激、脂质过氧化被认为是推动疾病进展的重要机制[3]。谷胱甘肽(glutathione，GSH)是细胞内最重要的抗氧化分子之一，不仅参与清除活性氧(reactive oxygen species，ROS)，还是谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(glutathione peroxidase，GPX)的必需辅因子，GSH将脂质过氧化物还原为无毒脂质醇，从而抑制脂质过氧化累积、减轻氧化损伤，促进内源性及外源性有害物质的解毒[4]。近年研究[5]表明，GSH缺失诱导肝细胞应激、损伤和死亡，造成肝脏纤维化，导致肝硬化和HCC。新近研究[6-7]发现，铁死亡和铜死亡均与氧化还原失衡、脂质过氧化积累及金属离子稳态异常密切相关，参与MASLD进展。GSH含量降低会增加ROS和脂质过氧化，继而促进铁死亡和铜死亡，参与MASLD的发生与发展[4, 6-7]。本文旨在总结MASLD中GSH调控铁死亡和铜死亡的进展，为探究MASLD新的治疗靶点提供证据。

GSH在MASLD中的作用

GSH由谷氨酸、半胱氨酸和甘氨酸组成，是真核细胞中最丰富的天然活性肽，也是哺乳动物细胞中最常见的非蛋白硫醇[8]。维持细胞内氧化还原平衡状态的抗氧化系统主要分为3类：还原型谷胱甘肽/氧化型谷胱甘肽(oxidized glutathione，GSSG)系统、谷氧还蛋白(glutaredoxin，Grx)系统及硫氧化蛋白(thioredoxin，Trx)/Trx还原酶系统。前2个系统均需要GSH提供电子供体，因此GSH是维持生物体内氧化还原稳态最重要的小分子活性物质[9]。

细胞内GSH的稳态依赖于一个由合成酶、再生酶、结合酶及降解酶精密调控的网络，该网络常被称为GSH抗氧化系统[10]。其核心包括2个方面：合成与再生循环。GSH的合成主要分为2步，由腺苷三磷酸(adenosine triphosphate，ATP)驱动的酶促反应：首先，谷氨酸和半胱氨酸在谷氨酸半胱氨酸连接酶(glutamate-cysteine ligase，GCL)的催化下生成γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸，这是GSH合成的限速步骤；随后，谷胱甘肽合成酶(glutathione synthetase，GS)催化甘氨酸与γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸结合生成GSH[11]。在发挥抗氧化作用时，GSH在GPX的催化下，将电子提供给过氧化物(如脂质过氧化物)，自身被氧化为GSSG。随后，GSSG在谷胱甘肽还原酶(glutathione reductase，GR)和还原型烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸(nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate hydrogen，NADPH)的作用下被还原再生为GSH，从而维持细胞内极高的GSH/GSSG比值。这一循环是维持细胞氧化还原稳态的核心机制[10]。

抗氧化系统在MASLD发病机制和疾病进展中发挥关键作用，作为抵抗氧化应激的主要防御物质，GSH主要集中在肝脏，对肝脏健康至关重要[12]。研究[13]发现，GSH能有效抑制大鼠体内抗坏血酸诱导的肝微粒体和线粒体不饱和脂肪酸发生脂质过氧化。GSH含量下调、GSH依赖性抗氧化剂活性降低是MASLD恶化的机制[14]。在MASLD早期，代谢改变限制了甘氨酸的可用性，损害了GSH的合成，从而加剧了急性肝毒性[15]。随着疾病加重，GSH/GSSG比值下降，这提示氧化应激和GSH耗竭存在于MASLD整个过程中[16]。鉴于GSH耗竭在MASLD进展中的重要作用，通过外源性物质靶向调控GSH代谢已成为潜在的干预策略。例如，黄芩苷可通过影响GSH的从头合成途径有效缓解MASLD[17]；对肝脂肪变性小鼠补充甘氨酸，可通过支持GSH的从头合成来减轻对乙酰氨基酚诱导的肝毒性[15]。肝脏GSH氧化还原系统及其在MASLD进展中的失代偿过程见图1。
